en.t: Let us compare it with something else:

units.source_text: 譬如细木工人，凭自己的匠心造出种种器物来。

en.t: for example, a fine woodworker creates all kinds of objects through his own skill and ingenuity.

units.source_text: 如果是临时用的玩赏之物，其式样没有定规，

en.t: If it is only an object for temporary amusement, with no fixed rules for its form,

units.source_text: 那么随你造成奇形怪状，见者都认为这是时势风尚，

en.t: then no matter how strangely you shape it, everyone who sees it will take it as the fashion of the times,

units.source_text: 有意改变式样以符合流行作风，是富有趣味的。

en.t: and deliberately changing the design to suit the current style has its own charm.

units.source_text: 但倘是重要高贵的器物，是庄严堂皇的装饰设备，

en.t: But if it is an important and noble object, a dignified and splendid furnishing,
one that has a fixed and proper form,

units.source_text: 那么倘要造得尽善尽美，非请教真正高明的巨匠不可。

en.t: then if you want to make it perfectly, you must seek instruction from a truly accomplished master.

units.source_text: 他们的作品，式样毕竟和普通工人不同。

en.t: After all, the design of their work is different from that of ordinary craftsmen.
